# Schlinger: You can find them here

![Schlinger: You can find it here](/uploads/281_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**Slingers** are the descendants of pre-war salamanders. They usually stay near water and usually sleep hanging from trees. Slingers reside in Appalachia in the **Swamp** and **Cranberry Bog**. You do not enter any buildings or climb stairs. They also have the ability to slowly regenerate their health.

There are several challenges in which you have to find Schllinger. Furthermore, Schllinger are interesting for carnivore builds even without the challenges, as you can cook salami rolls from the innards, which give you a significant carrying capacity boost.

## Places with rolling

![Schlinger Lagoon in the swamp area](/uploads/nukaknights-schlinger-find-schlinger-lagune-.jpg) 

The first and easiest port of call is the Schlinger Lagoon. Here you will find 4 Schllinger for your challenges or for salami rolls (Perk: Don't forget the extra sausage under Perception).

Tip: You can get the recipe for **salami rolls** from Molly (Raider / Crater) from 88 bottle caps as soon as you have increased your reputation with the raiders to "neighborly". See: Wastelander's Plans at Raiders / Settlers Listed by Merchant and Reputation / Gold Plans of All Factions

## More places with lurches

- You can always find two Slingers north-west of **Dyer Chemical**
- **Event: Moonshine Party** (at Sunday Brother'S Cabin). Many waves of lurches spawn here
- 33.33% chance of lurching spawns at the **Treetops (Swamp)**
- 25% chance of lurching spawns on **Pylon V-13**
- 20% chance of lurching spawns at the **Dolly Sods Campground**
- 10% chance of lurching spawns on **Beckwith Farm**
- There are also many **Random Encounter** locations and **Horden Events** where you can meet Schllinger.

Sources:

- Nuka Knights Gameplay
- Fallout 76 Wiki
